name: Rich-text article body

items.note: Three independent block schemas, each fully closed. Using oneOf rather than a shared base + patches, because draft-07's additionalProperties:false on a shared base cannot see properties a sibling allOf branch adds.

constraints.contentProvenance: The real article bodies are NOT in the clone. src/data/posts.js carries original placeholder prose written for the clone, deliberately not the original articles. Titles, covers and tags ARE genuine. A generator must not mistake the placeholders for source content and must not attempt to 'restore' the originals.
constraints.noInlineCta: There is no inline body CTA slot on the original.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: col-lg-8 inside .container.cc-narrow. Paragraphs 16px/24px weight 500 with a 16px gap at every breakpoint.
responsive.le479: same; no type-scale change on body prose.
